new.name: Barr Damsel
new.description: John Barr's damsel nymph with a barred marabou tail, a tippet-ribbed scud-back body of Spectra Ice dubbing, mallard flank wings and mono eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly near weed beds on a floating line with a long leader.
steps: Tie in the mono eyes behind the hook eye.
Tie in a slim barred marabou tail.
Dub the body, pull the scud back over it and rib with tippet.
Tie mallard flank wings on each side and figure-eight dubbing around the eyes.

new.name: Barr's Tungstone
new.description: John Barr's weighted golden stonefly nymph with biot tails, a Lateral Scale flash strip, a Thin Skin shellback, a sow scud body, tippet rib and hen legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep as the point fly in a two-nymph rig.
steps: Add the bead and lead and tie in split biot tails.
Tie in the rib, Lateral Scale and Thin Skin.
Dub the body, pull the flash and shellback over and rib it.
Tie in hen legs at the thorax and pull the shellback forward again to the bead.

new.name: Black and Peacock Spider
new.description: Tom Ivens' simple lake fly with a fat peacock herl body and one or two turns of black hen.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it very slowly near the surface on lakes.
steps: Tie in three or four peacock herls at the bend.
Twist them with the thread and wrap a full body.
Tie in a black hen hackle and wind two turns.
Build a small head and whip finish.

new.name: Blae and Black
new.description: A Scottish loch fly for buzzers, with a black body, a silver wire rib, a black hen hackle and a grey mallard wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a middle dropper when midges are hatching.
steps: Build a slim black body and rib it with silver wire.
Tie in a black hen beard.
Pair two mallard slips and tie them on top.
Finish a small head.

new.name: Epoxy Buzzer
new.description: A stillwater buzzer with a thread abdomen and rib, flat wax cheeks and an epoxy or UV coat that sinks it fast.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a long leader under an indicator or a slow figure-of-eight.
steps: Build a slim tapered thread abdomen around the bend.
Rib it with a contrasting thread.
Tie in orange cheeks on each side at the thorax.
Build the thorax and coat the whole fly with resin.

new.name: Chubby Muffin
new.description: A sculpin streamer with pseudo eyes, a grizzly rabbit tail, a sculpin SLF body, red schlappen gills, hen back fins and a craft fur head.
new.fishing_tips: Bounce it along the bottom in riffles and runs.
steps: Tie on the eyes and a rabbit strip tail with flash.
Dub a full SLF body.
Add red schlappen gills and hen back fins on each side.
Build a craft fur head around the eyes and trim it broad.

new.name: Dusty Miller Spider
new.description: A North Country spider with an orange silk body, a peacock herl thorax and a woodcock hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it upstream in a team of spiders.
steps: Wrap a slim silk body.
Add a short peacock herl thorax.
Tie in the woodcock feather by the tip.
Wind one or two turns and finish.

new.name: CDC BWO Emerger
new.description: A tiny BWO emerger with a CDC shuck, a kapok dubbing body and a CDC wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film to selective trout during BWO hatches.
steps: Tie in a short CDC tuft at the bend as a shuck.
Dub a slim kapok body.
Tie in a CDC wing.
Dub a little in front of the wing and finish.

new.name: Grenadier
new.description: An old soft hackle with a red or orange seal's fur body, an oval tinsel rib and a light badger hen hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it on lakes and rivers when sedges hatch.
steps: Tie in the rib.
Dub a tapered seal's fur body.
Rib the body.
Wind two turns of badger hen and finish.

new.name: Silver Blue Bumble
new.description: A Kingsmill Moore bumble with a crest tail, an oval silver body, bright blue and badger palmered hackles and a teal front hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on the top dropper for sea trout and lake trout.
steps: Tie in the crest tail.
Wind the oval tinsel body.
Palmer the blue and badger hackles and rib with wire.
Wind a teal front hackle and finish.

new.name: Morgan's Midge
new.description: A small emerging midge with a root beer Krystal Flash shuck, a CDC wing and a grizzly hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to sipping trout in winter and early spring.
steps: Tie in a short Krystal Flash shuck.
Build a thin thread body.
Tie in a CDC wing.
Wind two turns of grizzly and finish.

new.name: Popham
new.description: A classic full-dress salmon fly with a three-section body veiled with Indian crow, a crest tail and a married wing, tied on a blind eye hook.
new.fishing_tips: A display fly for collectors and classic tiers.
mats: Three sections of floss, each veiled
steps: Fix the gut eye and tie the tag and crest tail.
Build three body sections, each finished with an ostrich butt and crow veils.
Add the throat hackle.
Build the married wing and finish the head.

new.name: Quill Body Jig
new.description: A slim euro jig nymph with a Coq de Leon tail, an olive stripped peacock quill body coated in UV resin and a hellgrammite SLF thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a tight line through riffles.
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in a Coq de Leon tail.
Wrap a smooth quill body.
Coat the body with thin UV resin.
Dub a small thorax behind the bead.

new.name: Rabbit Candy
new.description: Bob Popovics' rabbit strip baitfish with a flash body, stick-on eyes and a UV resin head, tied on clear mono thread with a foul guard.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for striped bass and sea bass; the rabbit moves on the pause.
mats: Hanked flash such as Polar Flash
steps: Tie in a mono foul guard at the bend.
Tie a rabbit strip on top so it extends past the hook.
Tie a bundle of flash around the shank as the body.
Add eyes and coat the head with UV resin.

new.name: Rubber Leg Hare's Ear
new.description: A green drake nymph version of the Hare's Ear with a tungsten bead, turkey casing, superfloss legs and a resin-coated back.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep before the green drake hatch.
steps: Add bead and lead and tie in the tail and rib.
Dub the abdomen and rib it.
Tie in the turkey casing and flash, dub the thorax with legs.
Pull the casing over and coat it with resin.

new.name: Sedgehog Bibio
new.description: A Bibio version of the Sedgehog with roe deer hair wings tied in along the body and a black, red and black seal's fur body.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a bob fly in a wave.
mats: Roe deer hair, tied in stages
Black, red and black seal's fur
steps: Dub a short black section and tie in a bunch of roe deer.
Dub a red section and add more deer hair.
Dub a black front section and add the last bunch of hair.
Wind a black hackle and trim the hair to a sedge shape.

new.name: Sulphur Spinner
new.description: A sulphur spinner with microfibbet tails, a turkey biot body, snowshoe rabbit spent wings, a UV flash wing case and a sulphur dubbing thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it at dusk when sulphur spinners fall.
steps: Tie in split microfibbet tails.
Wrap a biot body.
Tie in spent snowshoe wings and the flash wing case.
Dub the thorax and pull the flash over.

new.name: PMD Thorax Dun
new.description: A thorax-style PMD with a dun hackle tail, a superfine body, a turkey flat wing and a dun hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to risers during PMD hatches.
steps: Tie in a turkey flat wing at the thorax.
Tie in the tail.
Dub the body.
Wind the hackle around the wing and trim a V underneath.

new.name: Tungsten Surveyor
new.description: Lance Egan's flashy nymph with a tungsten bead, a rainbow sow scud body, a silver rib, a pearl wing case and an orange thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as an attractor in a euro rig.
mats: Orange sow scud or Ice Dub
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in the rib.
Dub the abdomen and rib it.
Tie in the tinsel wing case.
Dub an orange thorax and pull the tinsel over.

new.name: Watson's Fancy
new.description: A classic winged wet fly with a tippet tail, a red and black floss body, a gold rib, a black throat and black duck wings.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in a team of wets on lakes.
steps: Tie in the tippet tail and rib.
Wind a red then black floss body.
Rib it and add a black throat.
Tie in the black wing.

new.name: Marabou Baby Tarpon
new.description: A simple tarpon fly with a brown marabou tail flanked with red grizzly saddles, red crinkle flash and a red saddle collar.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly around mangroves for juvenile tarpon.
mats: Brown marabou with red-dyed grizzly saddles
steps: Tie in a marabou tail with a grizzly saddle each side.
Add red flash.
Wind a red saddle collar.
Build a short red head.

new.name: EZ Black Drum Fly
new.description: A quick fly for black drum and redfish with small lead eyes, an arctic fox tail, Aqua Veil and a Foxy Brush body with a weed guard.
new.fishing_tips: Drop it in front of tailing drum and twitch it.
steps: Tie on the eyes so the hook rides up.
Tie in a fox tail and flash.
Wrap the brush and Aqua Veil forward.
Tie in the weed guard and finish.

new.name: Kind Herb
new.description: A small bonefish shrimp with bead chain eyes, a shrimp polar fibre tail, shredded pearl braid and a Laser Dub body.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it short and slow in front of cruising bonefish.
steps: Tie on the bead chain eyes.
Tie in a polar fibre tail with shredded braid.
Dub a Laser Dub body.
Brush it out and finish.

new.name: Bonefish Puff
new.description: A classic bonefish fly with bead chain eyes, a white calf tail and grizzly wing, pearl flash and a pink chenille head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in shallow water with short strips.
steps: Tie on the bead chain eyes near the eye.
Tie in a calf tail wing with grizzly hackles and flash.
Wrap pink chenille around the eyes as a head.
Finish.

new.name: More Bitchin' Bream Fly
new.description: A panfish fly with bead chain eyes, a pearl Krystal Flash tail and underbody, a D-Rib body, a pseudo hair wing and orange legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly near beds and cover.
steps: Tie on the weight.
Tie in the flash tail and wrap a flash underbody.
Wrap D-Rib forward.
Tie in a pseudo hair wing and legs.

new.name: Bully Bugger
new.description: A big white bugger for bull trout with a marabou and Flashabou tail, a Simi Seal body, a pearl rib and a white saddle hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it deep in big rivers for bull trout.
mats: Woolly bugger marabou and pearl Flashabou
steps: Wrap lead wire.
Tie in the tail and flash.
Dub the body and palmer the hackle.
Rib it and finish.

new.name: Klamath October Caddis Skater
new.description: A big October caddis skater with an Ice Dub body, tan foam, a mallard and elk wing and an orange hot spot.
new.fishing_tips: Skate it across riffles at dusk for trout and steelhead.
steps: Dub an Ice Dub body.
Tie in the foam strip on top.
Tie in the mallard and elk wing.
Add the eyes and hot spot.

new.name: Carp-It Bomb
new.description: A carp fly with black bead chain eyes, an olive brown marabou tail and wing, barred flutter legs and a Carp Dub body.
new.fishing_tips: Drop it in front of feeding carp and let it settle.
steps: Tie on the bead chain eyes.
Tie in the marabou tail and legs.
Dub the body.
Tie in a marabou wing and overwing of dubbing.

new.name: Cat Boobie
new.description: A stillwater booby with a white marabou tail and wing, a cat green straggle fritz body, red throat and yellow foam eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a fast sinking line with a short leader.
steps: Tie in the marabou tail.
Wrap the fritz body.
Tie in the wing and throat.
Tie on the foam eyes.

new.name: Golden Girl
new.description: A streamer or steelhead fly with an orange tail, a gold tinsel body, an orange throat, an orange calf underwing and a golden pheasant tippet wing.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for steelhead or strip it for trout.
steps: Tie in the tail.
Wind the gold body.
Add the throat and underwing.
Tie tippet feathers on top.

new.name: Grayling Quill Jig
new.description: A tiny jig nymph for grayling with a tungsten bead, a UV-coated quill body, a squirrel and flash thorax and a CDC hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a tight line in slow runs.
mats: Peacock quill coated with UV resin
Grey fox squirrel and UV flash
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in the tail.
Wrap and coat the quill body.
Dub the thorax.
Wind one turn of CDC.

new.name: Convict Killer
new.description: Scott Null's sheepshead fly: lead presentation eyes and a black rabbit zonker tail and body, with a heavy mono weed guard.
new.fishing_tips: Drop it beside pilings and barnacles where sheepshead feed.
steps: Tie on the eyes and weed guard.
Tie in a short rabbit tail.
Wrap a second strip forward.
Close the weed guard.

new.name: Jig Head Saltwater Shrimp
new.description: A small jig-hook shrimp with a pink tungsten bead, white yarn head, pink bucktail feelers, shrimp eyes and a palmered grizzle hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for sea trout, bass and small saltwater species.
steps: Slide on the bead.
Tie in the head, feelers and eyes.
Dub the body and palmer the hackle.
Finish.

new.name: Snookie Shrimp
new.description: A snook shrimp with bead chain eyes, a polar fibre tail, rubber legs, black flash and a body of brown and grizzly saddles coated with UV.
new.fishing_tips: Drift it under dock lights at night.
steps: Tie on the eyes.
Tie in the tail, legs and flash.
Palmer the saddles forward.
Coat the back with UV resin.

new.name: Super Stretch Squid
new.description: A hot orange shrimp or squid with polar fibre feelers, Super Stretch hackle legs, shrimp eyes and a Blob Fritz body.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for bass, sea trout and pollock.
mats: Hot orange polar fibre or craft fur with Krystal Flash
steps: Tie in the feelers and flash.
Add the legs and eyes.
Wrap the fritz body.
Trim and finish.
